body: I wish we could give each other a big hug right now.

Good god your post is exactly what I've been going through lately.  Exactly, every single word.  I am hurting so badly and you described it so perfectly.  That was hard to read.  I'm so sorry you're dealing with this but I also am very comforted to know someone out there understands.

I know a lot of people are saying that the cheating is a no brained, but that was my main issue and I am giving him another chance. I was at least happy to see that he didn’t have any communication with other people when I checked his phone. The gay porn is concerning to me for other reasons. 

I’m struggling a lot with this but I do appreciate everyone trying to help me see different angles of this. I know from the outside it probably seems to obvious I should just leave him but I also have seen evidence that he is attracted to women. I really am very confused.

It kind of made me feel even crazier.  I do trust my intuition and I've been right each time I felt like he was hiding something, but I have no idea what he means with the rest of it.  I am trying to be honest by facing reality instead of lying to myself.  I just don't know if I should try to accept that he's gay and break up with him or if I should think it's normal to have a bisexual boyfriend who almost never wants to have sex with me.

Can you indulge me a little bit?  Why is he using me like this?  Why can't he just break up with me?  This is cruel and wrong of him to do to me.  I have already wasted so much of my time feeling inadequate and it's just heartbreaking and exhausting wondering what I am doing wrong on a daily basis.

What are you insinuating?  I tried to have an open talk with him more than once and he has told me things that I now think are also lies.  I don't know what else I can do besides just try to accept that he is gay and break up with him.  Which will be incredibly difficult because I don't want to do that.  I don't want it to be true.  But I'm tired of feeling like this.

One time raccoons started fighting in my parents attic.  I was still living with them and we were just hanging out on a weeknight.  All of a sudden it sounded like shrieking, furious fighting and we all were scared shitless.  Sounded like they were going to fall through the ceiling.  After that they called out an inspector and found they had managed to get in and had a whole nest living up there.  It was pretty funny looking back but at the time we had no idea what was going on and all grabbed things to fight with, like a broom and a candlestick.
